source.name: Pressure
source.originalDescription: When Mewtwo deals damage to enemy players with a basic attack, the Mega gauge increases up to 8 times. As the Mega gauge increases, Mewtwo's Attack, Defense, and Sp. Def are increased by 2%, up to 10 times. If Mewtwo is level 5 or higher, and the Mega gauge has increased at least 8 times, it Mega Evolves. The Mega Evolution lasts 10s and increases Mewtwo's Attack by an additional 18%, Defense and Sp. Def by an additional 18%, max HP by 10%, movement speed by 5%, and has a fixed attack speed. Consumes up to 30 Aeos Energy upon Mega Evolving. Mega Evolution duration is extended by 1 second for every 5 energy consumed. Energy is consumed regardless if you have the next multiple of 5. The Mega gauge does not deplete upon being KO'd. When Mewtwo deals damage to an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, the Mega gauge increases. Each time the Mega gauge increases, Mewtwo attack is increased by 2% and its Defense and Sp. Def are increased by 2%, up to 10 times. If Mewtwo is Lv. 5 or higher, and the Mega gauge has stacked at least 9 times, it Mega Evolves. The Mega Evolution lasts 15s and increases Mewtwo attack by an additional 10%, Defense and Sp. Def by an additional 10%, its max HP by 10% and its movement speed by 5%.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Pressure は 攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる、防御・特防を変化させる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる、KOまたはアシストで発動する。

source.name: Infinite Psyburn
source.originalDescription: Mewtwo becomes unstoppable while revealing enemy players and channeling a powerful attack on the enemies' current position. After 1s, Mewtwo brings down a powerful psychic beam on their original position, dealing damage to enemies around each point of impact, leaving them unable to act for 1s and decreasing their Defense by 20% for 3s. Each Pokémon can only be hit by 1 psychic beam. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Infinite Psyburn は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、防御・特防を変化させる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、遅延または時間差でダメージを与える。
